_extraction_flags.notes: Excellent Fiber-ISAC paper! DSCM + φ-OTDR with LFM probe pre-compensation using forward comm feedback. OECC/PSC 2025. 2×120 Gbps + 1m resolution, 2.4 dB SNR improvement.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: LFM waveform distortion due to frequency response |H(ω)|, ACF comparison shows noise floor reduction with pre-comp. Fig.2: Experimental setup - Laser→DP-IQM→40km SMF+PZT→dual receivers with feedback loop. Fig.3: Rayleigh traces, phase waterfall, PSD showing 2.4 dB SNR improvement, STPR tradeoff curves.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: DSCM-based Fiber-ISAC. Sensing: Chirped-pulse φ-OTDR (CP-φ-OTDR) with LFM probe. Communication: 2× 30 GBaud 16-QAM DSCM. Key innovation: Forward comm extracts amplitude-frequency response |H(ω)| → Pre-compensates LFM probe distortion at TX. Closed-loop calibration.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 2×120 Gbps (2× 30 GBaud 16-QAM), BER near SD-FEC limit. Sensing: 1m spatial resolution (500 MHz LFM bandwidth), 200 Hz vibration detected, 22.1 dB PSD SNR, 2.4 dB improvement over uncompensated. 40 km fiber length. STPR=10 dB optimal.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: Novel closed-loop sensing probe calibration using forward communication channel state. Addresses LFM distortion from EDFA gain tilt. Gap: Single PZT location (not truly distributed test), limited to weak perturbations.

bibliographic.title: Pre-compensation of LFM Sensing Probe via Integrated Sensing and Communication over Fiber System
bibliographic.authors: LIU Maoqi, WANG Jingchuan, LIU Chen, YU Changyuan, LU Chao

application.scenario_description: Distributed fiber optic sensing (DFOS) with communication overlay for large-scale infrastructure monitoring (temperature, strain, vibration).

key_contribution.key_contribution: Closed-loop LFM probe pre-compensation using forward communication channel response |H(ω)|. Forward comm provides real-time frequency response → TX pre-distorts sensing probe → 2.4 dB SNR improvement.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: LFM probes in CP-φ-OTDR suffer frequency-dependent distortions from EDFA gain tilt, causing mismatched filtering and degraded SNR/resolution.

transmitter.notes: NKT E15 narrow linewidth laser. Sensing: LFM probe 70-570 MHz (500 MHz BW). Comm: 2× 30 GBaud 16-QAM DSCM with 2 GHz guard band. DP-IQM for comm, IQM for sensing. AWG: Keysight 8196A + 8190A.

receiver.notes: Shared LO for comm and sensing. Comm: DP-Hybrid + 4 BPDs. Sensing: Hybrid + BPDs. RTO: Keysight DSAZ594A (comm), MSOS404A (sensing). OBPF + FIR filter for sensing isolation.

integration.notes: Sensing probe (70-570 MHz) + Comm DSCM (separate band with 2 GHz guard). Shared laser, separate modulators. Feedback loop for pre-compensation.

waveform.notes: LFM probe for φ-OTDR sensing, 16-QAM DSCM for communication. FDM multiplexed. Pre-distortion based on S_PD(t) = F^-1{S(ω)·|H(ω)|^-1}.

channel_fibre.notes: 39.1 km SMF + 1m PZT (200 Hz vibration) + 255m SMF. EDFA amplification.

comm_metrics.notes: 2×120 Gbps total (2× 30 GBaud 16-QAM). BER approaches SD-FEC limit (1.5e-2) at high STPR. SC2 more affected by fiber nonlinearity.

sensing_metrics.notes: 1m spatial resolution via 500 MHz LFM BW. 200 Hz vibration detected at 39.1 km. 22.1 dB PSD SNR. 2.4 dB SNR improvement with pre-compensation. 10m gauge length. RVS algorithm for fading elimination.

tradeoff.notes: STPR (Sensing-to-Telecom Power Ratio) optimization. STPR=10 dB optimal: sensing SNR improves, comm BER stays below FEC. Higher STPR degrades SC2 due to fiber nonlinearity.
